verdict.rationale: Whether user data is excluded from AI model training is a fair privacy question for a password manager, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack addresses AI training, data-use policies, or any opt-out control. The llms.txt files, MCP servers, and CLI items concern AI-readable docs and agent integrations, not training data use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
